integrity: Complete original proof with algebraic identities and a reproducible supplementary checker. Classical theorems invoked in stated hypotheses; literature priority provisional. No external audit.
limitations: The certified mu upper endpoint is optimal only among radial power-weight globally nonpositive Dulac divergences; no claim about onset of cycles beyond it. The family is globally Hurwitz only in a separately established smaller parameter region; global attraction to one invariant set is false.
title: A weighted-Dulac global phase portrait for a three-dimensional Hurwitz counterexample family
